description: Search performance over time for the whole site or a single page — is it getting better or worse, did a change have an effect. Weekly by default, daily with granularity=day when an exact date matters. Includes Plausible visitor data for the same buckets where the integration is connected. Responses follow the account language (German by default).

domainId.description: Domain id of one of the user's projects, as returned by list_domains.

granularity.description: Resolution of the series, defaults to week.

path.description: Path of a single page. Omit for the whole site.

name: traffic_trend
title: Traffic trend
